parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing exposure is documented: no criminalisation, no birth-sex facility or custody rule, no border friction, no police targeting. Positives are substantial and in force — declaration-based legal recognition, discrimination law covering goods and services, hate-crime aggravation for 'change of sex', marriage/adoption equality, an equality body and a national LGBTIQ+ organisation, plus case-by-case prison placement that expressly avoids stigmatising isolation and honours chosen address. What caps the score: no evidence of documented social acceptance of visitors specifically, no demonstrated enforcement cases (aggravating-factor application unverified, action plans criticised as incomplete), no nonbinary marker, and gender expression unprotected. The record is institutional rather than visitor-tested, so it sits below the acceptance-plus-proven-enforcement anchors but well above ones with any universal exposure.
